A '''First Order lieutenant''' was stationed the on [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the ''[[Thunderer]]'', a [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] under the command of [[First Order]] [[Agent]] [[Tierny]] and [[Commander]] [[Pyre]] during their search for the [[supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]''. After the [[First Order TIE fighter pilot|First Order TIE Fighter Pilot]] [[cadet]] [[Tamara Ryvora|DT-533]] was persuaded to hand in her personal [[comlink]] because [[Resistance]] member [[Kazuda Xiono]] had sent a transmission to it, the [[lieutenant]] informed Pyre and Tierny that the cadet's comlink had been decrypted, allowing the ''Colossus'' to be located at the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]], where a [[Battle of D'Qar|battle]] had recently been fought as the main body of the Resistance evacuated their [[Resistance base|base]] there.<ref name="AQSR" />

After the Star Destroyer's arrival in the [[Ileenium system]], the lieutenant informed Pyre and Tierny that the [[sail barge]] ''[[Galleon]]'', belonging to the [[Warbird gang]] of [[pirate]]s which had formerly worked for the [[First Order]] prior to being [[Torra Doza's abduction|betrayed]], had been scanned inside the wreckage of the [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought]] ''[[Fulminatrix]]''.<ref name="AQSR" />

The lieutenant was killed during the [[Battle of Barabesh]], when the battlecruiser was destroyed by the [[Team Colossus|''Colossus'' Resistance]], killing the entire crew.<ref name="The Escape">{{Resistance|The Escape (episode)}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This First Order officer first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|Season 2]] episode "[[A Quick Salvage Run]]." He was voiced by [[Jonathan Lipow]].<ref name="AQSR" />
